answer: The bond is locked for 41 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the relic lockup is enforced by the ledge escrow, the opal audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large swarm therefore freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants burn once per identity. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
